scheme_name: Snehayanam Scheme For Mothers Of Persons With Special Needs
other_conditions: Widowed, legally divorced, or abandoned by husband are eligible
Mother must be of a person with disability covered under the National Trust Act
Applicant must have a valid three‑wheeler driving license
Applicant must have no steady source of income
Vehicle tax and insurance will be borne by the beneficiary
Vehicle must be registered solely in the beneficiary’s name and cannot be transferred or sold
benefits_summary: Free electric auto‑rickshaw provided to eligible mothers of persons with disabilities who are financially disadvantaged.
